# Forum debate: Sidious + Plagueis + Tenebrous vs Krayt + Caedus + Valkorion (Suspect Insight)

**URL:** https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t224-darth-sidious-darth-plagueis-darth-tenebrous-vs-darth-krayt-darth-caedus-valkorion [panel: panels/sidious/sidious-darth-sidious-darth-plagueis-darth-tenebrous-1.png; panels/vitiate/vitiate-darth-krayt-darth-caedus-valkorion-1.jpg]
**Pages read:** 1 of 1 (15 real posts; `t224p20-...` returns an empty "Information" page). Raw: `forum-raw/t224.html`. Dates: 16-17 May 2019.

## Conditions (OP Gᴏᴀᴛ)
- Team 1: **ROTS** Sidious, prime Plagueis, prime Tenebrous.
- Team 2: prime Krayt, prime Caedus, prime Valkorion. One all-out team fight. The OP's pictures are on servimg; we did not open them.

## Arguments
- PeraltaEagle45: "Caedus is too much of a weak link though, and Sidious is the MVP. It's close, because both Krayt and Valkorion are above Plagueis." After he noticed it was ROTS Sidious: "Team 2 then for sure, as Krayt and Valkorion are both stronger than Sidious by this time."
- NevesYtneves (DC77) gives the clearest scaling: "Valkorion>ROTS Sidious. Krayt<Plagueis. Caedus>Tenebrous. Team 2, good fight."
- Guest: "Valk is the strongest here (by a significant margin as well)".
- DarthAnt66: "Team 2. Valkorion's far too strong."
- LSDMB (team 1): "I probably have a higher opinion of Tenebrous and Plagueis than most". He gives no specifics. Replies tease him about Bane ("Bane is a planet buster. Valk is not", The Fallen Warrior, which is a joke).

## Counterarguments and rebuttals
None were developed. The thread is verdicts only. The one swing point: if Sidious were a later version (ROTJ or DE), PeraltaEagle45 implies team 1 does better.

## Verdict tally (POSTER OPINION)
Team 2: 8 (PeraltaEagle45, DC77, Guest, The Lost, dark-sith123, Blade_of_Dorin, DarthAnt66, plus The Fallen Warrior leaning: "i wanna say sidious solos, but its a lot more complicated with krayt involved"). Team 1: 1 (LSDMB). Unsure: 1 (Master Azronger: "Legitimately not sure").

## Scaling chains used
- Valkorion > ROTS Sidious; Krayt < Plagueis; Caedus > Tenebrous (DC77, 2019).
- Krayt > Plagueis and Valkorion > Plagueis (PeraltaEagle45). Note that DC77 and PeraltaEagle45 **disagree on Krayt vs Plagueis**.

## Conflicts with our notes
- "Valkorion > ROTS Sidious" clashes with the accolades in `sidious-comicvine-respect.txt` (e.g. "the most powerful Sith Lord in history", New Essential Chronology). In later SI threads (see `debates-sidious-vs-vitiate.md`) Master Azronger and others answer it with exactly those quotes. The 2019 SI consensus here is opinion only, and no feats are cited.
